name: Shanghai Dynasty
author: Addicting Games
description: Shanghai Dynasty is a free mahjong game. Welcome to the Shanghai Dynasty. This is a new game but it's also in many ways a classic game of pattern recognition. Put your matching skills and strategic know-how to the test in this classic tiled game of symbols and elimination. In Mahjongg, 144 tiles are placed face-up on the board, and it’s up to you to clear the board by removing pairs of matching tiles. While being easy to explain, and technically easy to play, Mahjongg is far more challenging than you could possibly believe, this is why it lasted for thousands of years. It has a deep strategy and a cool aesthetic.  You only win if you clear the board. Run out of moves while there are still tiles to be played, and you lose. we think you can do it, take a quick trip to Shanghai and enjoy the exotic locales.
